h: Moses Bliss and wife share romantic night-out video amid marriage rumours
p: Gospel singer Moses Bliss and his wife Marie have shared a video of a romantic evening together, which fans see as a response to rumours of trouble in their marriage.
body: Gospel singer Moses Bliss and his wife, Marie Wiseborn Bliss, have shared a video of a romantic night out, which many fans see as a response to rumours about their marriage.

The clip, posted on Moses Bliss's Instagram page on Tuesday, 17 November 2026, showed the couple leaving an upscale restaurant in the evening. He wore a black tuxedo and bow tie, while she wore a fitted red dress. He helped her into a waiting car as they left. The post was captioned with a single word, serenity.

Unverified stories about trouble in the couple's marriage have circulated on social media several times. Neither of them had directly addressed the claims, but fans took the video as a quiet way of shutting them down.
Broadcaster Do2dtun, however, argued that the couple's video actually lent weight to the rumours rather than ending them, drawing further debate online.
more: The couple shared a video of a night out.
Rumours of marriage trouble had spread online.
Neither has directly addressed the claims.
